_meta.description: Submission surface manifest: classifies every file or file family in the NeurIPS supplementary package by submission role. Built from ci/bundle_manifest.json (110 files) plus additional artifacts. See ci/submission_surface_check.py for validation.
policy_notes: expected_in_submission=true means the file should appear in the reviewer-facing supplementary ZIP.
role=internal_or_excluded means the file is NOT shipped to reviewers; hashes are tracked for provenance only.
hash_policy=required means the artifact should appear in bundle_manifest.json with a verified sha256.
hash_policy=inherited_from_result_json means the artifact is enumerated in a result JSON; hash tracked there.
hash_policy=excluded means the artifact is not shipped and hash tracking is optional.
